en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a rural lakeside landscape with rolling grassy hills in the foreground. Several people sit on the hillside looking toward a cluster of wooden houses and farm buildings surrounded by long wooden fences. In the background is a large lake bordered by low, rounded hills. The caption at the top left reads "Parti fra Sjusjøen". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century Scandinavian countryside scene.
